svg.aria-label: The evidence pack one QA run leaves behind, built for a stranger: a root manifest with a COVERAGE decision and a generated index; a REPORT pinned to a commit and a clock; a Given/When/Then report with no code-speak; a six-sheet Excel workbook to ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119-3 that never invents a value; a debate file with the verifier's card and a fresh challenger's card; and one folder per case named for what it proves, holding a manifest with TITLE, KIND, EXPECTED, ACTUAL and RESULT plus screenshots with an exact-fit box and the caption below. Four gates keep it honest: evd_check, evd_index --check, xlsx_export --strict and bdd_report_check. Shape gates keep the record disciplined; truth comes from the commit pin, the re-runnable measurement and the challenger.
svg.text: The evidence pack — built for a stranger, kept honest by four gates and a challenger
What one /qa run leaves in evd/<TICKET>/. Every field named here is demanded by a script, not by a style guide.
evd/TB-4/
manifest.md
COVERAGE: security ✓ a11y ✓ — decided, not implied · index by evd_index
REPORT.md
COMMIT: 16b5576 · VERIFIED-AT · ORACLE: spec §§ · verdict readable in two minutes
REPORT.bdd.md
Given / When / Then — an observable Then; no file paths, SQL or routes in the body
TB-4_testcases.xlsx
6 sheets — Summary · Test Cases · Defects · Traceability · Evidence · Images
debate.md
card 1 the verifier · card 2 a fresh challenger on another model · dissent kept
TC_2_a_second_contact_with_the_teams_address_is_refused/
manifest.md
TITLE · KIND: acceptance · AS/ENTRY/AFTER/BACK · EXPECTED · ACTUAL · RESULT
01_form_filled.png
named for what it shows
02_refusal_boxed.png
exact-fit box on the verdict region, caption burned in below
TC_5_each_field_is_refused_one_step_past_its_limit/
KIND: boundary — one step past each limit; the pack must hold one
TC_8_twelve_simultaneous_saves_create_exactly_one_contact/
KIND: acceptance, NON-UI — a DB constraint proved by a race, with db_verify.md
TC_10_the_media_list_survives_the_new_contact/
KIND: whole-screen — the pack must hold one
02_refusal_boxed.png — what the box looks like
This e-mail already belongs to a contact of Aozora Creative Agency
▲ The refusal names the team that already holds the address (spec §4.3)
caption below the image, never on it — pixel coordinates stay measurable;
the box is 4 px around the region, never inflated to look important.
evd_check
no TITLE/KIND, a judgement-word EXPECTED, a URL-only ENTRY, no boxed png,
a claim no file backs → red
evd_index --check
an index older than its cases → red
xlsx_export --strict
an undeclared value is named, never invented
bdd_report_check
a Then that says nothing observable → red
+ the challenger
rebuilds the measurement with its own tools; both cards are kept
What the gates can and cannot prove
Shape gates keep the record disciplined — every case has a kind, a claim and a file. Truth comes from three other things: the verdict is pinned to a commit
and expires when the code moves, every number is a re-runnable measurement, and a challenger with empty context tries to falsify it before the ticket closes.
